name: atenea
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Atenea instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Atenea tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Atenea through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Atenea Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Atenea only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
